answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, and to earn trust slowly, like a glacier, rather than instantly. A public beacon publishes random audit challenges, and only identities that answer consistently over weeks gain full trading rights. Spinning up thousands of fakes then costs real locked funds per identity plus weeks of honest work, while a velvet-smooth path still lets one genuine newcomer join cheaply and grow.
